english.title: Leave an uncovered refuse container / drop litter / deface Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[left an uncovered refuse container on]_
(B)_[dropped, left, threw or deposited a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING..), that would or is likely to cause, contribute or lead to damage to property on]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4.20 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
